summary: The study describes the Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) deposition of titanium dioxide thin films using titanium isopropoxide and water as precursors. The process is limited to temperatures below 350 °C due to the thermal decomposition of the alkoxide. The films were characterized by various techniques, and the growth mechanism was found to be self-controlled. The study also compares the ALE process with the chloride-based process, highlighting differences in growth rates and film properties.
